Biography A former IRA bomber, Dorian Reid became an informant for the Secret Intelligence Service in 1993 after a bomb he had planted in a Belfast fish shop detonated prematurely, causing him to lose an arm in the process. The IRA pinned the blame on him, resulting in his cooperation with SIS, whose Q Branch built him a new prototype limb in exchange for valuable intelligence. The limb in question was derived from CANDU reactor maintenance technology, the hand is as capable of lighting a match as it is moving control rods in a nuclear furnace. Since that time, Reid went rogue and was last seen ransacking a medical supply facility on the western outskirts of Baghdad, Iraq. name: Fatima Blunt
text_excerpt: Fatima Blunt is a fictional undercover journalist who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage. Game biography The daughter of a British explorer and a high-ranking Iraqi Baathist general, Fatima was raised between England and the Middle East. Notably, MI6 attempted to recruit her at Cambridge University. Trained as a journalist, her outspoken nature has gotten her into more than a few tight spots, but through a combination of luck, wit and determination, she manages to make the best of her difficulties and move on.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. James Bond discovers Blunt while searching for rogue bomber Dorian Reid in the 8th century ruins north of Baghdad, Iraq. After she obtains a photograph of Reid, the pair commandeer a jeep and flee from the approaching insurgents. name: Khalid Al Sakran
text_excerpt: Khalid Al Sakran is a freedom fighter and Secret Intelligence Service informant who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage. Biography Cunning and patient, Khalid was forced to join in raids against neighbouring groups from a young age. He bided his time before he made contact with a young, naïve British woman captured by insurgents and held captive in Algeria. When she was freed, she carried his coded message to MI6. An alcoholic living deep undercover among Islamic radicals, Khalid keeps his disguise intact by killing any man who sees him drink. Fortunately for him, the local life expectancy is so low that he has yet to attract suspicion.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. Khalid teams up with James Bond whilst he infiltrates an Iraqi prison where militants had taken Fatima Blunt and her camera filled with evidence. text_excerpt: Tiffany Case is a fictional American diamond smuggler who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage. The character is a re-imagining of the literary and film character who first appeared in Ian Fleming's 1956 novel Diamonds Are Forever and was subsequently adapted for EON Productions' 1971 James Bond film of the same name. Game biography Voluptuous and deceitful, Tiffany Case was raised by a brothel Madame on the US West Coast. As a girl, she was attacked by a rival gang. Independent and mistrustful, she has little to do with men, except on a professional basis.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. Infiltrating the same diamond-smuggling pipeline which financed terrorist Dorian Reid, James Bond (travelling as Peter Franks) is met by Svetlana Koroleva on arriving in Las Vegas and is passed along to the gang's courier Tiffany Case. After being wined and dined by the protagonist she provides the name of her boss, a powerful socialite named Ruby Cox.

Is it possible that the deprivations suffered by her family at the hands of the National Socialists has left an indelible mental scar? text_excerpt: Leyla Artemita is a fictional Kurdish militant who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage during its "Dead Again Tomorrow" plotline. Game biography After the massacre of her fellow Kurdistan Workers' Party (Kurdish: Partiya Karkerên Kurdistanê‎, PKK) members, Leyla struck out on her own with a clear vision of the future that involved, neither socialism nor passive acceptance of Turkish dominance. As skilled at tracking antelopes as she is at hunting men, few have escaped once she is on their trail.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. James Bond teams up with the her to find rogue bomber Dorian Reid. The pair raid an Iraqi bunker, where Leyla casually mows down the bombers within. She suffers from post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and is skilled in firearms, tracking and stealth, and is multi-lingual, speaking Kurdish, English, Turkish and Arabic. name: Papa Diablo
text_excerpt: Papa Diablo is a courier and former member of the Yakuza who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage during its "From Russia with Love" story-line. He was portrayed by Marcus Natividad. Biography Turning his back on the clan that raised and trained him was no easy choice, but after what he saw one night in Bangkok, Popa could no longer live with the consequences of his actions. After drifting for a year, he found a new calling and began to hunt down and eliminate those who he had previously called friends.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. Biography Working his way into a United Nations post at an early age, Abu has made friends across the world. Charismatic and practical, his economic skills are sometimes used to funnel money in and out of difficult places, or to trace others attempts to do the same. Noted for being corrupt, he keeps a little in his own pockets.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. Game biography Born in Nice, France, the smuggler Justine Dubois is noted for her misanthropy, preferring the company of women. At the professional level, she acts as a useful bridge between her uncle's criminal enterprise, her brother's connection to the Deuxième Bureau and the vast European smuggling ring into which she has inserted herself.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. She points him in the direction of Anaelle Brouchard, who was given the key by her jealous 'friend', Ludovic de Baleine. Game biography As the oppression in her home state increased to the point where life was nearly unbearable, Hei Ding's parents chose to hide her very existence from the authorities. Raised in the mountains and forests surrounding her home place, Hei Ding remains unassimilated into the dominant socialist state surrounding her. Instead, she lives in a dream-like world populated by her imagination. Traditional Korean nature spirits make up most of her 'friends'. Game biography Daughter of a worker in a large Soviet era arms plant, Yana became disgusted with how the modern weapons her father manufactured were used to control and oppress the Kazakh people. Fleeing to the wilderness Yana went rogue and learned to live in a traditional manner, hunting on horseback with bow and arrow. Unsatisfied with her role as a rural woman, Yana travelled back to civilisation and began working as an assassin based out of Ulaanbaatar. In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. name: Benoit Dubois
text_excerpt: Benoit Dubois is a French intelligence asset who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage, during its Slow Down Faster story-line. Biography Born in Marseille in France, Benoit is brother to Justine Dubois and nephew of Rene Dubois. He is the technical side of the family and is involved in all manner of plots, from those sanctioned by the Deuxième Bureau, to those that deal with shady underworld car races. Benoit is skilled in driving, firearms and surveillance, and is multilingual, speaking French, German and English.In-game agent dossier, James Bond: World of Espionage. Benoit was assigned to assist James Bond by his sister Justine and drives him to the mountain villa of Ludovic de Baleine. name: Dragomir
text_excerpt: Dragomir is a professional assassin employed by Ludovic de Baleine. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage, during its Slow Down Faster story-line. Biography After James Bond uncovers Ludovic de Baleine's scheme to completely destroy the European Union's currency and seize control of the European Union in its wake, the self-proclaimed Dauphin sends Dragomir – a tall and immensely strong assassin – to pursue and kill the British spy. The pair fight on-board a cable car high above the Alps, and later on skis. Dragomir pursues the spy on skis, down a hill to the edge of a large icy lake, with 007 narrowly escaping in a boat belonging to smuggler Rene Dubois.
